meta.name: My Bias, My Boss
meta.description: A dedicated fangirl lands a job at a fashion company, only to discover it was co-founded by her ultimate idol. Determined to remain professional, she hides her identity, but is quickly thrown off course by the company's workaholic CEO. As secret unrequited feelings and hidden personal struggles entangle the trio, she finds herself torn between her lifelong obsession and an unexpected new connection.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: To work beside her idol, Da-reum joins a startup but instead faces a prickly, suspicious CEO.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Da-reum aims to be employee of the year in order to travel with her idol, Chan, but her enthusiasm only triggers her CEO's deep suspicions.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Da-reum finds herself caught in a love triangle.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Ha-gi and Da-reum grow closer on a secret business trip.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: A major shift changes everything after the season's first snow.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Ha-gi prepares to confess his true feelings -- only to be blindsided at the crucial moment.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: A harsh boycott throws the company into chaos.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Ha-gi and Da-reum's secret office romance is put to the test.
